name: Indus Valley
startIntroPart1: Though little is known of the people within the settlements of the Indus Valley, their presence is felt through the many ruins left behind by some of humanities earliest attempts at forming civilization.
startIntroPart2: May this be the start of a great rise of your people. Shall we embrace civilization together?
declaringWar: It is unfortunate it has come to this... The people have gathered against you.
attacked: You want to attack the people? Together I'm sure they can repel you.
defeated: It is sad we would be enslaved and erased. It was good while it lasted.
introduction: Greetings from the Indus River Valley. Civilization is nice isn't it?
neutralHello: How are you doing? Today finds you well I hope.
hateNo: We are not agreeing to that!
afterPeace: It is fortunate things would resolve for the better.
tradeRequest: We believe this would be mutually beneficial.
denounced: Your insults disperse across the realm.
